firm_data.firm_description: Neighbors Link Community Law Practice is the legal arm of Neighbors Link, providing a full array of immigration legal services, from citizenship applications to removal proceedings, representing immigrant New Yorkers from around the world.
notable_facts: Provides legal services to both detained and non-detained individuals, including adults and children.
Represents clients in NY Family Court, U.S. Federal courts, Immigration Courts (EOIR), The Board of Immigration Appeals (BIA) and before DHS (ICE and USCIS).
Offers a weekly Immigration Law Helpline on Thursdays from 8 a.m. - 8 p.m.
